label: Snap zones
behaviour: The work area; each layout below tiles it with the frames a snapped window takes. On a portrait display each layout turns a quarter, its columns becoming rows (the tall profile's observation holds those frames)

label: Selection: how far a selected entry grows past each side
Entry size
behaviour: Every entry is the same height and its width follows the window's shape: Untitled - Notepad 366 by 285; Windows - File Explorer 348 by 285; a selected entry grows 10 px past each side

label: Opening selection
behaviour: Opens with Windows - File Explorer selected, the entry after the active window

label: Tab with Alt held
behaviour: Each Tab moves the selection one entry on and the last wraps to the first: Windows - File Explorer then Untitled - Notepad then Windows - File Explorer

label: Title row
behaviour: Each entry carries its window's title as its name; UI Automation exposes no separate title element, so the row's look is in the shot

label: Dragging to an edge or corner
behaviour: Notepad's title bar carried to each side edge and corner of the work area and let go

label: Drag to the left edge
behaviour: While held, the drop preview fills the left zone (0, 0, 960, 1032) exactly; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands left at (0, 0, 960, 1032)

label: Drag to the right edge
behaviour: While held, the drop preview fills the right zone (960, 0, 960, 1032) exactly; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands right at (960, 0, 960, 1032)

label: Drag to the top left corner
behaviour: While held, only (292, 0, 668, 516) of the top-left zone (0, 0, 960, 516) changed; the pointer is on the top edge, where the drag also opens the snap layouts bar over it; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands top-left at (0, 0, 960, 516)

label: Drag to the top right corner
behaviour: While held, only (960, 0, 359, 516) of the top-right zone (960, 0, 960, 516) changed; the pointer is on the top edge, where the drag also opens the snap layouts bar over it; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands top-right at (960, 0, 960, 516)

label: Drag to the bottom left corner
behaviour: While held, the drop preview fills the bottom-left zone (0, 516, 960, 516) exactly; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands bottom-left at (0, 516, 960, 516)

label: Drag to the bottom right corner
behaviour: While held, the drop preview fills the bottom-right zone (960, 516, 960, 516) exactly; new top-level windows: XamlExplorerHostIslandWindow at (0, 0, 1920, 360). Let go: lands bottom-right at (960, 516, 960, 516)

label: Rename
behaviour: Puts the first desktop's name into editing (no edit box that UI Automation exposes); typing replaces it and Enter commits: ['Desktop 1', 'Desktop 2'] became ['work', 'Desktop 2']

label: Snap bar reach from the top edge
Picking a window in snap assist
behaviour: Fills the empty zone: Notepad at (0, 0, 960, 1032), File Explorer at (960, 0, 960, 1032) on a 1920 by 1032 work area, and the two become a snap group

label: Closing a desktop
behaviour: Its windows move to the desktop on its left and stay open
